_comment: Pre-registered before any simulation ran. Thresholds, mixes and seeds are fixed here; tests read this file and must not edit it. Sim results never touch real hardware; live claims are listed under live_probes and stay unverified until run.

unit.U1_netlink: Parser decodes a v6.6-format THERMAL_GENL_EVENT_CPU_CAPABILITY_CHANGE (event 14, nest attr 20 holding repeated u32 attrs 21/22/23) into {cpu: (perf, eff)}; rejects truncated attrs.

sim.S1_win: auto beats the best baseline by >= 10% mean weighted throughput in at least one mix
sim.S1_kill: exhaustive_static within 3% of auto (auto/best_static < 1.03) on all 5 mixes -> claim (1) killed in sim
sim.S2_ablation: in every mix where auto beats unpinned by >= 5%, both ablations (constant-S, counters shuffled across pods) must lose >= 50% of that margin; otherwise the sim result is void
sim.S3_probe_error: under M3, the concurrent passive probe has lower median |log(S_est/S_true)| than the sequential two-balloon probe

live_claims_not_tested_here: claim (1) on the 13900T with RAPL energy
claim (2) HFI-reactive p95 under PL1-saturating E load; gate: >= 1 HFI change/min
claim (3) AMX fencing on SPR or later
